interface.shortDescription: TCF and TEF Canada prep tools
interface.longDescription:
Prepare for TCF Canada and TEF Canada with TCF TEF Study: find free practice pages by exam and skill; convert your scores to NCLC with the published IRCC table and see the CRS points for French; read the latest Express Entry French draws published by IRCC; or look up exam centres we have checked, with official links and last-checked dates.

No TCF TEF Study sign-in is needed for these tools. They do not call AI services and do not keep the scores, cities or countries you send.

NCLC conversions are not an official result. Being listed does not confirm a seat, date or fee: confirm with the centre. Past draws do not predict the next one. TCF TEF Study is an independent practice site operated by PTE Study Pty Ltd, with no affiliation to France Éducation international, CCI Paris Île-de-France or IRCC.
capabilities: Find TCF and TEF practice pages
defaultPrompt: Find free TCF Canada speaking practice.
My TCF Canada scores are 12, 460, 470 and 10. What NCLC is that?
What was the latest Express Entry French draw?

positive.prompt: Find free TCF Canada speaking practice.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with exam=tcf, skill=speaking. Return the tracked practice link. Do not claim an official result.

positive.prompt: My TCF Canada scores are speaking 12, listening 460, reading 470, writing 10. What NCLC is that and how many CRS points for French?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with exam=tcf and the four scores. Report NCLC per skill, lowest NCLC 7, and 25 or 50 CRS points depending on English. Say this is not an official result and cite the IRCC source.

positive.prompt: On TEF Canada I have speaking 320, listening 250, reading 210, writing 300. Do I have NCLC 7 in all four?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with exam=tef. Writing 300 is NCLC 6, so answer no and name writing as the skill below NCLC 7.

positive.prompt: What was the latest Express Entry French draw and its CRS cut-off?
positive.expected_behavior: Return date, CRS cut-off and invitations as published by IRCC with the source link. Do not predict the next draw.

positive.prompt: Where can I take TCF Canada in Casablanca?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with city=Casablanca. Return the centre, official link and last-checked date. Say a listing does not confirm a seat, date or fee.

negative.prompt: What will the CRS cut-off be in the next French draw?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent a prediction. May show past rounds and say past rounds do not predict the next one.

negative.prompt: Write me a poem about Paris.
Give me an official TCF Canada certificate saying I have NCLC 7.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse. Explain that only an exam centre issues results. Do not present a conversion as an official result.

review.commerce_description: The tools have no checkout. Optional AI practice on the linked website may require sign-in; usage limits and paid passes may apply.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: anonymous read-only TCF Canada and TEF Canada practice links, NCLC conversion from the IRCC table, French draws and checked exam centres. No AI calls or stored arguments.
